name: commit-then-project
body:
Ordering: the durable file write and its git commit happen FIRST — the commit is the system-of-record durability point — and only then is the exact projection delta applied. No query may ever observe uncommitted state that a crash plus rebuild would revert.

Acceptance: a process that dies after the durable commit but before the projection apply is reproduced correctly by the next rebuild (the committed state, never the uncommitted projection); a process that dies before the commit shows the mutation in neither the durable store nor the projection.
